newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tanker runs aground, spills crude in Tokyo Bay.
newsitem.headline: Tanker runs aground, spills crude in Tokyo Bay.

text.p: A large tanker spilled crude oil after running aground in Tokyo Bay on Wednesday morning, a spokesman for the Maritime Safety Agency (MSA) said.
He said the ship was the Panamanian-flagged Diamond Grace. He had no information on whether anybody had been injured in the incident.
The 255,000 dead-weight-tonne tanker was on its way to Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd's 75,000 barrel-per-day refinery at Kawasaki, near Tokyo, a spokesman for the Japanese firm said.
The Diamond Grace is classified as a "Very Large Crude Carrier", the second-largest classification for oil tankers.
The Mitsubishi Oil spokesman said no further information was immediately available.
